# AutoConvert Digital

> Marketing that just works. AutoConvert Digital fixes what happens after the click, so more of a business's leads become sales. Based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, working with businesses Australia-wide. Founded and run by Luke Wade.

The full website is launching soon. Until then, contact sales@autoconvertdigital.com.au.

## What we do

- The Click-to-Close Circuit™: a seven-stage system covering every step between someone clicking an ad and paying the invoice: Offer & Ads, Destination, Capture, Qualify, Engage, Close, Maximise.
- Meta Campaign Audit: $97
- Campaign Build & Test: $3,500
- Meta ads management: $2,000 per month
- Landing pages, lead capture and CRM setup, speed-to-lead and follow-up automation, conversion copywriting

Prices exclude GST. Every price is published. Management is a flat fee, never a percentage of ad spend.
